title: Arithmetic Operators in C++
learningObjectives: Explain the key idea in arithmetic operators in c++.
Identify the relevant syntax and rules.

understand.concept: Arithmetic operators perform numeric calculations. C++ includes addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and remainder. Integer division discards the fractional portion, and remainder is defined for integral operands.
understand.whyItMatters: Calculations are central to counters, measurements, totals, formulas and game logic.
understand.analogy: Think of this as a control or calculation rule that tells a program how to handle a particular situation consistently.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a starting point; C++ syntax, types and execution rules determine actual behaviour.
understand.explain:
## Basic operators
`+`, `-`, `*`, `/` and `%` perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and remainder. `%` requires integral operands.

## Division
When both operands are integral, division produces an integral result. To retain fractions, ensure a floating-point operand is used.

## Order and safety
Parentheses clarify intent. Avoid division by zero and be aware that signed integer overflow is undefined behaviour.
